interventions.description: Relocate utility poles to a dedicated furniture zone or underground to provide a clear, unobstructed walking path.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or a planting buffer between the sidewalk and the parking lane to improve pedestrian comfort and safety.

interventions.title: Tree Canopy Management
interventions.description: Prune low-hanging branches to ensure clear sightlines and an unobstructed walking path.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the degraded asphalt to provide a smooth, safe surface for all street users.

interventions.title: Tree Pit Management
interventions.description: Install tree grates or permeable paving around the base of the tree to maximize the usable walking surface while protecting the tree.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance Enforcement
interventions.description: Ensure a continuous clear path is maintained on the sidewalk by removing or relocating private furniture and storage.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to maintain low vehicle speeds in this residential setting.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening/Clearance
interventions.description: Reconfigure parking or tree pits on the right side to ensure a consistent minimum clear walking width.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Prune overhanging tree branches to maintain a clear vertical path and improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical separation from parked and moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Physical Separation
interventions.description: Install bollards or a raised curb to clearly delineate the pedestrian zone from the parking and travel lanes.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Planting street trees would provide a physical buffer between pedestrians and vehicles while improving the streetscape.
